title: Internet & Roaming
items: Activate your roaming package before departure.
Save screenshots of your hotel address and itinerary for offline use.
Make sure your main communication apps are signed in before arriving in China.

title: Payments
items: Use Alipay or WeChat Pay with the accounts you have prepared.
Keep some RMB cash as a backup.
Check the payment method before ordering food or transport.

title: Metro & Transportation
items: Make sure the destination station name is available in Chinese.
For taxis or Didi, show the full address in Chinese.

title: Packing & Equipment
items: Bring a power bank and charging cable.
Wear comfortable shoes for long walks.

title: Safety
items: Do not travel alone without informing the group leader.
Keep your passport and important documents in a safe place.
Use the Emergency button on the home page when you need help.
